# SiteDetailPage2: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on pages of this type that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `SiteDetail2Elements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## In the page

- **"Choose file" / "file"**: file field. Seen on 1 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /forms/file-upload). In `SiteDetail2Elements` as `CHOOSE_FILE_INPUT`: `enter().chooseFile(path)`.
- **"Export users as CSV"**: button. Seen on 1 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /forms/file-download). In `SiteDetail2Elements` as `EXPORT_USERS_AS_CSV_BUTTON`: `click().exportUsersAsCsv()`.
- **"Click"**: button. Seen on 1 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /keyboard/mouse-actions). In `SiteDetail2Elements` as `CLICK_BUTTON`: `click().click()`.
- **"Double Click"**: button. Seen on 1 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /keyboard/mouse-actions). In `SiteDetail2Elements` as `DOUBLE_CLICK_BUTTON`: `click().doubleClick()`.
- **"Right Click"**: button. Seen on 1 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /keyboard/mouse-actions). In `SiteDetail2Elements` as `RIGHT_CLICK_BUTTON`: `click().rightClick()`.
